name: Easy Sheet Pan Turkey Sausage & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches with Ranch-Dressed Salad

ingredients.name: turkey breakfast sausage patties, fully cooked

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Cut cheese slices into quarters. Set aside.
Place sausages on a microwave-safe plate and heat on high until just warmed through, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message: 8 turkey breakfast sausage patties, fully cooked

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, remove 4 biscuits from the package. Using your fingers, separate the top from the bottom portion of each biscuit and arrange on the baking sheet, opened-side facing up. Top each biscuit half with a quarter slice of cheese, a warmed sausage patty, and a second piece of cheese.
Separate remaining biscuits, then cover the "sandwiches" (with the open-side facing down), and press edges to seal.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until the biscuits are cooked through and golden, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the lettuce, along with dressing, and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 pint grape tomatoes
⅓ cup ranch dressing

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!
